questions.stem: Dots are placed in a $4$ by $4$ square array, with neighbouring dots $1$ unit apart. How many different squares, of any size and in any tilt, have all four of their vertices at dots of the array?
Words of $4$ letters are made from the letters $A, B, C, D, E, F$, and letters may be repeated. How many such words begin with $A$ and end with $F$?

A school canteen lets a student choose either a hot lunch or a cold lunch (not both). A hot lunch is one of $3$ mains with one of $2$ sides. A cold lunch is one of $4$ sandwiches with one of $3$ drinks. How many different lunches can a student choose?

A student at the same canteen chooses a hot lunch (one of $3$ mains with one of $2$ sides) and also a cold snack (one of $4$ sandwiches with one of $3$ drinks). How many different combinations of hot lunch and cold snack are possible?
